Hi Tim / Susan — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + proposed mutual action plan (MAP) milestones for the procurement/vendor onboarding path so we have a single source of truth. Please review and flag anything we missed.

Summary of agreement on call:
- HarborTech confirmed use-case: customer-facing knowledge assistant across support docs (initial).
- Procurement path: HarborTech will onboard Redwood as a vendor in both Ariba and Coupa to enable invoicing and future committed capacity.
- Target close: commercial approval + vendor enrollment by end of Q1 (target: 2026-03-31).

Draft MAP milestones (high level):
1) Vendor Forms & Tax — HarborTech to return completed W-9 and vendor enrollment form (owner: HarborTech procurement; due: 2026-01-25).
2) Ariba / Coupa Setup — HarborTech to invite Redwood to supplier portal and complete required fields (owner: HarborTech IT/Procurement; due: 2026-02-08).
3) Banking / ACH — HarborTech to provide banking instructions or complete Redwood banking onboarding doc (owner: HarborTech Finance; due: 2026-02-15).
4) Contract signature & PO issuance — finalize SOW & PO (owner: both parties; target: 2026-02-28).
5) Prod onboarding & smoke tests — Redwood enablement + verification (owner: Redwood SE; due: 2026-03-15).

Dependencies / notes:
- Ariba vs Coupa: we can accept either; if HarborTech uses both, we will complete the portal enrollment for the primary system first.
- W-9 and banking details are blockers for PO/payments; procurement will not issue PO without W-9 and vendor setup complete.
- If HarborTech requires a vendor security questionnaire (e.g., third-party security form), please share the doc and we will route to Security for an expedited review.

Attachments: I’ve attached a short MAP draft (HarborTech_MAP_v1.pdf) and a blank W-9 for convenience.

Next steps (proposed):
- Susan: can you confirm who owns the Ariba/Coupa invites and share the portal admin email?
- Tim: please confirm the W-9 PDF is the correct form and if HarborTech prefers ACH or wire instructions.
- Ben/Karthik (internal): we’ll prepare a short onboarding checklist for HarborTech’s supplier portal once Susan confirms the admin contact.

Thanks — I’ll wait for a quick confirmation and will upload the MAP to the HubSpot deal record once we have the procurement contact.
